startup.title: Startup time and idle memory
startup.what: Start with a new world until the server answers a status ping (cold), restart with that world (warm), then RSS and CPU of the empty, ticking server over 30 s.

redstone.title: Redstone: clocks, dust lines and pistons
redstone.what: 93 observer clocks, each driving a 15-block redstone dust line into a sticky piston that moves a block (1 395 dust, 93 pistons), on a platform at y 280.

mobs.title: Entity farm: 500 cows in a pen
mobs.what: 500 cows summoned on a grid in a 64 × 64 glass pen (mob AI, pathfinding, collisions, tracking for one player).

items.title: Dropped items: 2 000 item entities
items.what: 2 000 cobblestone item entities 1.25 blocks apart (no merging, no despawn, no pickup) on a platform.

hoppers.title: Hoppers: 1 024 hoppers moving items in rings
hoppers.what: 256 rings of 4 hoppers that pass a stack of 64 items around forever.

tnt.title: TNT: chain explosions
tnt.what: A 16 × 10 × 16 block of TNT (2 560) ignited in the air every 20 s, three times.

fluids.title: Flowing water and lava
fluids.what: 32 water and 32 lava sources placed on a walled 64 × 64 platform, removed again 10 s later, in turns (spreading and drying up).

light.title: Light updates
light.what: A 32 × 32 × 32 cube filled with glowstone and emptied again every 2 s (32 768 light sources appearing and disappearing, with block updates).

save.title: World save
save.what: 20 bots fly at boat speed (72.7 blocks/s) through new terrain for 60 s, then `save-all flush` until the server reports that everything is on disk.

vanillite.note: chunks on disk counted after the run (the count did not know the .vwr format yet)

pregen.title: World pre-generation
pregen.what: Generate the 101 × 101 chunks (10 201) around 0, 0 on 4 cores (Vanillite also on 1 and 2 threads), median of 3 runs. Vanillite: the chunk pipeline benchmark (`chunk_bench`: generation, light, storage, then loading the same chunks from disk). Paper: the Chunky plugin (radius 800, square) in the running server.

paper.method: Chunky 1.5.66: chunky radius 512, shape square, start

proxy.title: Proxy relay
proxy.what: Players join through a proxy on 30900 into Vanillite on 30901 (modern forwarding) and walk randomly: cost of the proxy process.

flight.title: Flying players: chunk delivery
flight.what: Bots fly straight at y 300 in random directions, first 50 with elytra speed (33.5 blocks/s), then 100 at boat speed (72.7 blocks/s): new terrain is generated and sent all the time; the movement check game rule is off on every server. Holes: chunks within 2 chunks of a bot that it does not have, sampled every 5 s. Full view: from connecting until every chunk within the view distance (circle) is there. Server CPU per chunk: CPU time of the server process divided by the chunks the bots received.

spread.title: Players spread out
spread.what: Bots fly to random points within 1 500 blocks of the spawn and stay there: every player has its own chunks.

join-storm.title: Join storm
join-storm.what: 1 000 bots join at 20 per second; then 1 000 more connect at once (up to 256 logins at the same time).

headline.label: time until the 1 000 more are in

environment.host: test server: 4 cores of an AMD Ryzen 9 5950X, 10 GiB RAM, Linux container (Ubuntu 26.04); other test instances on it stay mostly idle during runs
environment.bots: tools/loadbot on a separate machine in the same LAN (offline mode, no encryption)
environment.settings: seed -578941029922802438, normal world, peaceful, view distance 10, simulation distance 10, offline mode, pause-when-empty off, a new world per scenario

servers.vanillite: Vanillite dev 26.3, release-fast build, rule profile vanilla (paper profile as extra rows); memory limit 6 GiB
servers.paper: Paper 26.3 build 262, default configuration (Paper's own optimisations on), Java 25, -Xms1G -Xmx6G
servers.pumpkin: Pumpkin 0.2.2+26.3-26.60 release binary, defaults (no tick time report, so no MSPT)
servers.vanillite-proxy: vanillite-proxy from the same commit, modern forwarding

environment.mspt: Vanillite: every tick (tick log). Paper and Vanilla: `/tick query` every 5 s (P50/P95/P99/mean of the last 100 ticks), averaged over the window; max is the highest P99 window.
